name: plan
description: Create or replace a plan for a complex task. Each step states the action, reason, and primary tool. Keep statuses current with `plan_update`; call `plan` again if the task shape changes. Skip planning for simple one-step work.

action.description: What to do in this step (e.g., 'read src/main.rs', 'run cargo build', 'apply patch to fix X').

reason.description: Why this step is needed and what we expect to learn or achieve.

tool.description: Primary tool for this step (e.g. 'read_file', 'execute_command', 'apply_patch', 'knowledge_search'). Use 'none' if no tool is needed.

parallelizable.description: Whether this step can run in parallel with the previous step because no dependency exists. Default false; only meaningful for delegated work.

delegate.description: Whether to delegate this step. Set true for substantive bounded work; keep only trivial work, tightly coupled edits, and final review in the parent. Delegated steps run serially with `task` unless `parallelizable` enables concurrent `task_spawn`.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to accomplish the task.

summary.description: Brief one-line summary of the overall plan.
